plan.question: Do the gains from the inherited rank-based inverse-norm scale reassignment (scale_half_tangent, a half-rotation of eligible donor scales rather than multiplying gradients by one half) persist across prospectively paired initializations in both aligned and crossed field-product contexts? The verified seed-42 receipts show half-minus-full AUC changes of +0.00012049732767249743 for aligned products and +0.00046670504006685043 for crossed products; corresponding Logloss changes are -0.000030823655909423264 and -0.0003271451568329087. The crossed-minus-aligned AUC interaction is +0.000346207712394353, but this is one initialization under adaptively reused validation, not repeated mechanism support. Aligned half also regresses on both metrics for empty and 1-16-event histories; these are exploratory counterexamples to uniform benefit, not grounds for a new adaptive slice-specific architecture. Retrieve the complete local factorial, source-isolation and failed/negative magnitude trajectories before selecting a fixed replication/closure suite. The historical magnitude maximum must remain recorded alongside its unsuccessful score replay and later mixed signs; the trace-v1 execution failure is a separate condition. The next admissible contrast would preserve the existing two-by-two pairing/gradient configurations, capacity, training recipe and scoring contract, varying only authorized paired seeds. Consistent positive paired gains and a consistently larger crossed effect would support robustness of the local performance interaction; nonpositive gains, interaction reversals or source/forward/derivative violations would weaken or invalidate the respective claims. Generic gradient conditioning, embedding adaptation, checkpoint selection and execution sensitivity remain alternatives. This phase requests evidence only; any later repetition requires an exposed authorized interface and a complete budget including final assessment.
